REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - SEPTEMBER 9, 2010 - CITY HALL -
7:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.

4.

5.

6.

Consent Calendar
7.
Registers of Demands 9/9/2010
8.
Treasurer’s Reports for period ending 7/31/2010
9.
Approval of Minutes for 8/26/2010
10.
Miscellaneous
10A.
Award of Bid No. 1103-11, Printing of the 2011 Cerritos community calendar
End of Consent Calendar
11.
New and Old Business
11A.
Consideration of a proposal to amend a Ground Lease between the City of Cerritos and the Cerritos Towne Center , LLC and approval of a sub-lease between Cerritos Towne Center, LLC and Pacific Sales Kitchen and Bath Center, Inc. in connection with the location of Pacific Sales in the Cerritos Towne Center.
11B.
Consideration of a proposal to amend a Ground Lease between the City of Cerritos and Cerritos Investment, LLC, in connection with the retention of Best Buy Stores, LP within the Cerritos Towne Center and approval of an amendment to a sub-lease between Cerritos Investment, LLC and Best Buy Stores, LP.
11C.
Consideration of a request of the Cerritos Regional Chamber of Commerce regarding its 1/11/2011 City Council candidate forum.
12.

12A.

12B.
